# The script *schedule.*

Scripts shared by architects. Each one is checked for safety and adapted to work in any office and any Archicad language before it is listed.

 Opening soon The scripts move to this page, and the list appears here as soon as the first ones are in. Until then, the scripts shared so far are on the [current marketplace](https://tapir-marketplace.vercel.app/), and you can [share your own](https://archicad-api.com/scripts/share/).

Install

### Install a script

Open a script here and follow its *Install in Tapir* steps. In short: download it into a folder and add that folder to the Tapir palette. The website is for browsing; scripts run in Archicad.

[Step by step in Get started](https://archicad-api.com/start/#marketplace)

Share

### Share a script

Wrote a script that saves you time? Share it, and we help you make it ready for other offices. No GitHub account needed.
